parameters.text:
=Analyze this customer dataset and predict Customer Lifetime Value + segment customers.

Customer RFM Data:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.data) }}

For each customer:
1. Predict 12-month CLV based on RFM pattern
2. Assign segment: Champions / Loyal / At-Risk / Lost / New
3. Recommend specific action

Also provide overall analysis:
- Top 10% customers (Champions) — their characteristics
- At-Risk customers — what is causing churn signals
- Recommended marketing actions per segment

Return JSON:
{
  "customers": [{"email": "", "segment": "", "predicted_12m_clv": 0, "action": ""}],
  "segment_summary": {"champions": 0, "loyal": 0, "at_risk": 0, "lost": 0, "new": 0},
  "total_predicted_revenue_12m": 0,
  "champion_profile": "",
  "at_risk_signals": [],
  "segment_actions": [{"segment": "", "recommended_action": ""}],
  "summary": "3-4 sentence plain English analysis"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - CLV Predictor
Runs on 1st of every month.
Fetches all orders from Google Sheets.
Calculates RFM scores per customer (Recency, Frequency, Monetary).
GPT-4o predicts 12-month CLV and segments into: Champions/Loyal/At-Risk/Lost/New.
Identifies at-risk churn signals.
Saves monthly report + Slack digest.
